name: Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar Sanskrit Scholarship Scheme for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Students
benefit: **Scholarship Amount:** - Students from Class 6 to Class 12 will be provided ₹3,012/- per year, at the rate of ₹251/- per month.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a student studying in Class 6 to Class 12 at Sanskrit schools in Uttarakhand. 1. The student must belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe community. 1. A total of 200 students studying in Class 6 to Class 12 at Sanskrit schools in the state will be eligible for the scholarship. 1. The student must possess a valid caste certificate issued by a competent authority.
